overview_description.description: Fulcrum is a SaaS manufacturing platform designed and built from scratch to bring modern and futuristic concepts to small and mid-sized production shops. The product is a strong vote in favor of decentralized manufacturing, juicing up the system through connectivity and automation. Their long term mission is to create a connected manufacturing supply chain, reducing tedious data entry, and increasing the speed and efficiency of the entire network supported by the most kickass system available.

about_short_description.short_description: Fulcrum is a SaaS platform allowing manufacturers to improve efficiency through workflow optimization and automated data collection.

product.name: Job Tracking
product.description: A system that provides interactive instructions and collects live data from the shop floor to monitor job progress.

product.name: Job Scheduling
product.description: Automated job scheduling that optimizes production throughput by creating and adjusting schedules based on live data and priorities.

product.name: Job Costing
product.description: A tool that tracks live operation progress and calculates exact job costs by integrating BOM, routings, quality checks, and logs.

product.name: Grouped Work
product.description: A feature that allows grouping of jobs or work items for efficient nesting and production planning.

product.name: Quoting and Sales
product.description: A module for creating quick and accurate quotes and sales orders, integrating BOM import and historical data for pricing.

product.name: Purchasing Planning
product.description: A tool that analyzes demand, inventory, and lead times to provide live purchasing recommendations and streamline purchase order creation.
